verdict.rationale: Cognee is an AI memory engine, so integrating with real-time voice pipelines is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs or any voice integration. The documented integrations are data sources (Slack, Notion, Linear, GitHub) and MCP clients. The session cache's 'fast retrieval' is an adjacent feature, not a documented voice-pipeline integration, and there is no latency evidence for live conversation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
